text: common use checking coded open-ended answers, industry occupation codes assigned free-text descriptions. sketch uses textrecipes TF-IDF features penalised multinomial model. run vignette built, needs extra packages dataset survey description text column code factor. many fine-grained codes, start coarser level classification, every class enough examples stable thresholds, move coarse level clean.

what: Find examples with likely label errors — find_label_issues
title: Find examples with likely label errors — find_label_issues
text: Flags examples whose given label likely wrong, using one rank prune rules confident learning (Northcutt et al., 2021, Sec. 3.2). Every rule needs --sample predicted probabilities, example cross-validation. "prune_by_noise_rate" (default): every pair given label true label j, estimated number examples cell joint (see estimate_joint()) flagged among examples labelled , choosing p[j] - p[] largest. "prune_by_class": every given label , estimated number mislabelled examples flagged among examples labelled , choosing lowest self-confidence p[]. "": examples flagged rules . "confident_learning": examples -diagonal cells confident joint (see confident_joint()). "predicted_neq_given": examples whose likely class differs given label. simple baseline ignores class imbalance. cleanlab Python package, example whose likely class given label never flagged, whichever rule used: classifier offers evidence label. Flagged examples candidates review, proven errors: ambiguous examples genuinely fit several classes flagged .

title: Label quality scores — label_quality_scores
text: Scores likely given label correct, 0 (probably wrong) 1 (probably right). Scores depend predicted probabilities p example given label y (Kuan Mueller, 2022): "self_confidence": p[y], predicted probability given label. "normalized_margin": (p[y] - max(p[-y]) + 1) / 2, gap given label likely class, rescaled [0, 1]. Low another class clearly preferred. "confidence_weighted_entropy": ratio / (1 + ratio) ratio = p[y] / H(p), H entropy p divided log(K). Also low examples whose predictions spread many classes, examples belong none classes. adjust = TRUE, class threshold t (see class_thresholds()) subtracted predicted probabilities scoring. corrects classifier systematically favours classes. adjusted probabilities (p - t + max(t)) / sum(p - t + max(t)), non-negative sum one.

text: Finds examples whose given class label likely wrong, using --sample predicted probabilities classifier. Implements confident learning (Northcutt, Jiang Chuang, 2021) doi:10.1613/jair.1.12125 : per-class confidence thresholds, confident joint, calibrated estimates joint distribution given true labels, noise transition matrices, five rank--prune rules flagging label issues. Also provides model-agnostic label quality scores (Kuan Mueller, 2022) doi:10.5281/zenodo.18168246  per-class label health summary. Inputs can label vector probability matrix, data frame predictions, resampling results 'tune', predictions 'mlr3', fitted 'caret' model.
